text:
maya: Quick thread — need to reconcile RICE scoring across PMs before Friday roadmap sync. Several customer asks (SAML export, fine-grained logs) landed on different scales.

sam: Are we normalizing reach across segments? enterprise vs self-serve look very different.

olivia: +1. Proposed approach: compute percentile ranks per segment then average. keeps numbers comparable.

jt: Concern: that hides high dollar impact from single large customer. maybe weight by revenue?

maya: Good point. For Dedicated customers weight by ARR share. For hosted, use active DAUs. Want a reproducible rule.

casey: Also timeline/effort estimates vary wildly. Can we force 3-point estimates (low/likely/high) and pick median for effort?

adrian: Engineering prefers effort in dev-weeks, not t-shirt. We'll convert.

olivia: Sample recalibration: SAML export (customer ask) R=20,I=7,C=2,E=3 => score after normalization; will share spreadsheet.

sam: Suggest cap reach at 50% for platform features to avoid overcounting. :thinking_face:

jt: For launch criteria, require data-plane audit, e2e smoke, and 1 pilot customer. Documented.

casey: Can we table low-effort quality-of-life items into a 'quick wins' lane and not fight on RICE? Save debate time.

maya: Agreed. We'll make two buckets: Quick wins (<5 dev-days) auto-approve; Strategic (>5) uses RICE with normalized reach.

product-bot: Reminder: quarterly roadmap doc updated -> /docs/roadmap/q4 (edited by maya)

olivia: I'll run normalization script and post updated spreadsheet by EOB today.

sam: If someone (jt) can sanity-check weights, I can run the final scoring.

jt: I can do that. Ping me once spreadsheet is up.

maya: Thanks. We'll review in Friday sync. If we can't agree, tie-breaker goes to ARR-impact weighted score. :handshake:
